role: The living-mob model rasterizer: builds each vanilla mob's ModelBase parts and boxes (pig, cow, sheep, chicken, zombie, skeleton, creeper, spider, enderman, witch, slime, silverfish, pigman, ghast, blaze, magma cube, villager, iron golem, squid, bat, mooshroom, ender dragon, ender crystal), poses them as the model's setRotationAngles does, and draws them through the shared entity quad rasterizer with the renderer's extra passes (sheep wool, saddle, eyes, creeper armor, slime outer layer, enderman carried block, mooshroom mushrooms, shadow, dragon death beams and healing beam). The inventory's player preview (GuiInventory.func_147046_a: ModelBiped under the preview's rotations and standard item lighting) and BossStatus.setBossStatus from the dragon's draw.

structs.name: mob_box
structs.java: ModelBox (offset, size, grow, texture offset, mirror)

structs.name: mob_model
structs.java: ModelBase with its part list; child head offsets of ModelQuadruped

structs.name: xf
structs.java: the GL modelview matrix stack a ModelRenderer.render multiplies into

gpu: line 65-68, file scope: static mutable texture cache (textures, block_atlas, block_atlas_rgba, texture_assets) filled lazily from disk
line 1042-1051, function read_texture: fopen of state/<name>.rgba, then the cwd-relative csrc/assets/mobs and assets/mobs fallbacks (working-directory dependence)
line 1055, function read_texture: malloc per texture on first use
line 1093, function ensure_block_atlas: malloc of the 512x256 block atlas
line 1871-1876, function lastline: reads the whole frames.jsonl with getline and strdup per line
line 1901, function raster_mobs_scene: calloc of the mob input array per frame
notes: raster_mobs_draw is called from csrc/play/play.c for live frames and raster_mobs_scene from raster.c for recorded scenes. ModelSheep2/ModelSheep1 and other per-model method lists are inferred from the model_* function names and comments; I did not verify each model's angles line by line. Models not built here (wolf, ocelot, horse, snowman, wither, player/ModelBiped player path) are not drawn by this file. lane/entrender: armour passes with the glint (pose_armor, draw_armor), held items, the witch's potion and the golem's rose through raster_glx (draw_equipped, living_gl_base), the 180-degree death roll (death_max_rotation), the zombie villager (TEX_ZOMBIE_VILLAGER) and the conversion shake (corpse_yaw), the charged creeper's armour with depth writes, the eyes passes' additive second overlay, the fire overlay after the shadow, the witch nose's offsets, the biped legs' pivot z 0.1. lane/terender: mob_render_input.outer (outer_set) draws a mob under a camera-relative modelview of its own, TileEntityMobSpawnerRenderer's, skipping the range test and the shadow. lane/clientents: MOB_LEASH_KNOT (knot_draw, ModelLeashKnot) and the lead (leash_draw, RenderLiving.func_110827_b); the dragon's hurt pass keeps the lightmap.
